description: pygef is a Python parser for Dutch geotechnical measurements in GEF and BRO XML files. It reads cone-penetration and borehole records into typed objects with Polars tables and provides optional plots. Inputs are site investigation files; outputs include penetration depth, cone resistance, friction, soil descriptions and location metadata. Geographic scope follows the supplied files, with strong support for Dutch BRO formats; depth resolution depends on the measurement. MIT-licensed source is available on GitHub and PyPI. A limitation is that real records can vary in format and quality, and the maintainers request issue reports for files that do not parse. The optional plotting extra adds dependencies. pygef can prepare soil profiles for building foundations, subsurface assets and geotechnical hazard models. It is related to groundwater and subsurface tools but does not simulate ground behaviour itself. The documented example file was inspected in the README; no investigation records were downloaded.
name: pygef Dutch geotechnical file parser
